Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (September 4, 2019) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: Request for Quotation No. 4306-19-5036 Description: For the non-exclusive supply of all labour, equipment and material necessary to provide a Refrigeration Service programme, to maintain existing indoor/outdoor ice-making refrigeration equipment located in various arenas in North York District, as required by the Parks, Forestry and Recreation Division from the date of award to July 31, 2020, with the option to renew the contract for additional two (2) separate one (1) year periods at the sole discretion of the City and subject to budget approval(s).
